channel.description: Latest articles from The Hartford Courant (courant.com)

item.title: UConn women’s basketball routs Georgetown, 84-39, in Big East Tournament opener
item.description: The UConn women's basketball team dismantled 8-seed Georgetown 84-39 on Saturday to advance to the Big East Tournament semifinals.

item.title: Dan Hurley ejected as late run from UConn men comes up short in costly 68-62 loss at Marquette
item.description: Silas Demary Jr.'s last-second attempt through contact to tie Saturday's game went without a foul, leading to a Dan Hurley ejection and a 68-62 UConn loss at Marquette.

item.title: US detainees in Iran risk becoming collateral damage in war, families and supporters fear
item.description: Families and supporters of Americans detained in Iran say their loved ones face new dangers during the intensifying war.

item.title: Ford recalls 1.74 million of its cars over rearview display issues
item.description: Ford has issued two recalls affecting nearly 1.74 million of its cars in the U.S., due to software issues that impact the vehicles’ rearview camera displays.

item.title: No. 5 Creighton upsets No. 4 Marquette, advances to face UConn women in Big East semifinals
item.description: Creighton upset Marquette in the Big East Tournament quarterfinals to set up a semifinal matchup with the No. 1 UConn women on Sunday.

item.title: Trump pays respects to 6 US Army members killed in Iran war
item.description: President Donald Trump honored six U.S. servicemembers killed in Kuwait during the war with Iran, attending a solemn ceremony as their remains returned to home soil. item.title: President Trump grieves with families during return of soldiers killed in war in the Middle East
item.description: President Donald Trump on Saturday joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base at the dignified transfer for the six U.S. soldiers killed in the war in the Middle East.

item.title: Tia Chan, Kyle Josifovic lead UConn women to a thrilling OT win over Northeastern for Hockey East title
item.description: The UConn women's hockey team survivived nearly 85 minutes of hockey to beat Northeastern for the Hockey East title.

item.title: Big East wastes no time in lightening UConn coach Dan Hurley’s wallet following his tirade
item.description: UConn coach Dan Hurley was fined $25,000 for his conduct that led to an ejection in the final seconds of the Huskies' loss to Marquette on Saturday.
